back: A forecast where the parts add up to the totals at every level of the hierarchy: y = S times b.

front: What is the summing matrix S?
back: A 0/1 matrix. Each row shows which bottom series are added to make that series. Bottom rows are an identity matrix.
Bottom-up: forecast the bottom, then sum up. Top-down: forecast the total, then split by proportions. Bottom-up keeps detail, top-down is smoother.

front: Two ways to compute top-down proportions?
back: Average of proportions: mean of y_j(t) divided by total(t). Proportion of averages: mean of y_j divided by mean of the total.
Forecast all series, then adjust them to be coherent using b = (S'W^-1 S)^-1 S'W^-1 y_hat. OLS, WLS and MinT choose W.
The trace (total variance) of the reconciled forecast errors, using an estimate of the base error covariance W.
